snippet.title: Andromis - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
How long can you survive a city taken over by machines?

Andromis is a third-person action game packed with explosive missions where you fight rogue machines, rescue civilians, and battle through a collapsing city.

Switch between intense gunfights and high-speed vehicle combat as you unleash destruction on a massive scale.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4154160/Andromis/

💥 About the Game

🤖 War Against Machines
• Fight against rogue robots in a collapsing world
• Stop an invasion threatening humanity

🔫 Intense Combat
• Engage in fast-paced third-person shooting
• Use heavy weapons and explosive tools

🚗 Vehicle Warfare
• Drive cars, armored trucks, and tanks
• Break through enemy lines with raw power

🏙️ A City in Chaos
• Explore war-torn districts and industrial zones
• Battle across roads, ruins, and iconic locations

🎮 Action-Focused Experience
• Over 50 missions filled with destruction
• Inspired by classic 3D action shooters

⚠️ Content Warning
This game contains frequent violence including combat against enemies with blood and dismemberment, as well as themes of war and survival in a post-apocalyptic setting.
